summary: Post-market read for 2026-11-05. The fact layer was generated 23 minutes before the close, so every US equity and crypto figure here is a session snapshot rather than a closing print. The risk score is 71.40, high_risk and risk_off, the highest of the 69 sessions on record since 2026-08-03 and 7.33 points above the 2026-11-04 row at 64.07; trend_1d reads 7.63 because the same-day baseline is the 11:37Z generation at 63.77. This was an AI-complex unwind rather than a uniform flight: 20 of 22 sector and theme rows fell, memory by 15.4547 percent, AI infrastructure by 12.2225, networking by 11.9906, semiconductor equipment by 11.2022 and data centres by 9.1641; only digital advertising rose 1.5044 and gaming 1.0878. Single names did worse than their baskets: AMD 16.0317 percent lower, MU 14.8825, TSLA 11.0699, AVGO 9.5367 and NVDA 8.4245. Breadth broke with the tape: the 63-session new low share nearly doubled to 0.5096, or 80 of 157 names, and the share above the 200 day average fell to 0.2516, or 39 of 155. Credit did not follow, high yield OAS tightening to 3.32; the volatility dimension fell 5.87 points only because its VIX input is still the 2026-11-04 print at 16.61 while 20 day realised volatility rose from 12.8463 to 19.273. Bitcoin at 76042 is 5.2292 percent lower and copper 2.8112 percent lower; those flips lifted cross-asset confirmation from 0.50 to 0.875 and supplied 5.63 of the day's 7.33 points.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 0.875 contributes 13.12 points, the largest single item in the score, and almost all of the day's rise came from it: the dimension went from 4 of 8 scoring legs to 7, a gain of 5.63 points. Three legs flipped on the day, with SPY, bitcoin and copper all turning negative, while the other four are standing levels: the dollar index at 121.6656 above 105, the real rate at 2.65 above 1.5, small caps 5.081 points behind over 63 sessions, and gold positive on the day. Those standing legs do not move with the tape, so the dimension cannot fall quickly even if equities bounce.

Equity structure at 81.20 is the highest dimension and added 2.05 points. The 63-session new low share jumped to 0.5096, or 80 of 157 names, while the new high share fell to 0.0318, or 5 of 157, so both tails thinned at once. Breadth above the 200 day average fell to 0.2516, or 39 of 155. Semiconductors are 21.3517 points behind the index on the same 63-session window, which is a positioning fact rather than a single-day return.

Macro at 74.07 is essentially unchanged and is a level problem rather than a tape problem. The 10 year real rate holds 2.65 at the 97.99 percentile and the nominal 10 year sits at 4.95 at the 97.27 percentile, together contributing 9.63 points. Neither input moved on the day, so the dimension will not fall on stable equities; only lower rates relieve it.

Trend at 57.97 added 1.08 points as SPY lost its cushion. The index is now only 0.7022 percent above its 200 day average against 5.055 percent a generation earlier, 5.6219 percent below its 52 week high, with 3 month momentum at -4.9104. Less than 1 percentage point of headroom above the average is the day's most forward-looking technical change.

The AI complex carried the selling. Memory fell 15.4547 percent, AI infrastructure 12.2225, networking 11.9906 and semiconductor equipment 11.2022, while the four-name semis sector fell 12.2189; the single prints were worse, AMD 16.0317 percent and MU 14.8825 percent lower. The damage sits in the compute and memory capex chain, not in market-wide valuations.

supporting_signals.claim: Realised volatility at 19.273 is the only volatility input that moved with the tape; it rose against a falling nominal VIX, so the realised price action has happened and simply has not reached the score yet.

The overnight reverse repo balance fell to 0.125, halving the previous 0.225, with a single counterparty. The liquidity buffer is close to exhausted and there is no slack to absorb a shock before the payrolls print.
Semiconductors sit 21.3517 points behind the index over 63 sessions, so the leadership unwind predates today; the session released a relative weakness that already existed.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit did not confirm the equity move: high yield OAS tightened to 3.32 and investment grade to 0.91, which pulled the liquidity and credit dimension down 0.54 points to 74.74. If this were the start of a credit event, that dimension would have widened on the day, not narrowed.

The volatility dimension falling 5.87 points to 43.18 is a vintage mismatch: its VIX input of 16.61 is the 2026-11-04 close, not today's reading, while 20 day realised volatility has risen to 19.273. The dimension therefore understates today's stress rather than reflecting it.

It was not a blanket selloff: digital advertising rose 1.5044 percent and gaming 1.0878, while fintech fell 3.5503 percent on the day yet is still up 2.7123 percent on the week. Money rotated inside the market rather than leaving it.

what_changed_today: The layer was generated at 20:37:24Z, which is 15:37 ET, 23 minutes before the close, so the US equity and crypto prices are snapshots. Since the 2026-11-01 clock change the post-market slot has landed before the bell for a second consecutive session.
The score of 71.40 is a record high for the 69 sessions since 2026-08-03, and risk_off appears for only the second time in that record after 2026-11-02.

Of the 7.33 point day-over-day rise, cross-asset supplied 5.63, equity structure 2.05 and trend 1.08, against -0.88 from volatility and -0.54 from liquidity and credit, with macro flat at 74.07. The three price-driven dimensions supplied 8.75 points between them and the other two offset 1.42.

The -70.3532 on the semiconductors theme row is not a market move: its SOXX proxy series carries an unadjusted split in the 2026-11-05 bar, a roughly threefold gap across that single candle. The four-name semis sector at -12.2189 and NVDA at -8.4245 are the usable reads.

The China block is again the 2026-11-04 session: all 11 names up for a mean of 10.6763, identical to the 2026-11-04 pre-market generation, which is the post-market overwrite recurring again. The 2026-11-05 A-share session was carried by the 11:37Z generation, 7 of 11 up for a mean of 0.1658, and that vintage is no longer in the layer.
The dollar index at 121.6656 is still the 2026-10-30 print, four sessions behind the 4.95 ten year yield, so the macro dimension mixes vintages internally.

The regime_evidence string lists a VIX condition of 16.6 against a threshold of 28, which did not fire; the operative gate was breadth at 0.2516 below 0.35. The VIX limb should not be quoted as a condition.
watch_next: The Employment Situation report on 2026-11-06 at 13:30Z is the nearest event: 29 thousand on the prior print against 133 thousand before that, with unemployment at 4.2 percent. A second soft number would weaken the labour data and the macro dimension at 74.07 at the same time.
CPI on 2026-11-10 at 13:30Z, alongside the 10 year at 4.95 and the real rate at 2.65, is the main transmission path for the macro level problem.
Whether the 63-session new low share at 0.5096 extends: one session is an air pocket, two consecutive sessions are a trend.
High yield OAS at 3.32 is the main falsifier: if credit follows equities wider and clears 4, both the cross-asset and the liquidity and credit dimensions reprice together.
Nvidia's 2026-11-17 earnings, and the 2026-11-05 VIX close that has not yet reached the layer. Until that print lands, the volatility dimension at 43.18 should be treated as provisional.

bull_case.title: Bull case: breadth back above 0.35
points: Credit never confirmed the selloff: high yield OAS tightened to 3.32 on the day equities fell hard, which pulled the liquidity and credit dimension down 0.54 points. While credit stays calm this reads as a positioning event.
If breadth returns above 0.35 the risk_off gate stops binding and the score can fall back toward the 2026-11-04 level of 64.07.
Asia did not transmit the move: the 2026-11-05 A-share session was 7 of 11 names up for a mean of 0.1658, and the China memory supply chain narrative remains independent.

base_case.title: Base case: the score holds above 65
points: The volatility dimension is one session behind, so once the 2026-11-05 VIX lands the score is more likely to be revised up from 71.40 than down.
The 200 day average, with only 0.7022 percent of headroom, is the nearest technical line; holding it keeps the trend dimension near 57.97.
The 2026-11-06 payrolls print decides whether the macro dimension at 74.07 stays flat or moves.

bear_case.title: Bear case: breadth keeps deteriorating
points: If the 63-session new low share extends beyond 0.5096 for a second session, equity structure at 81.20 has further to run, because only 39 of 155 names above the 200 day average is already a minority.
Credit is the missing leg: a move from 3.32 through 4 would lift liquidity and credit at 74.74 while cross-asset already sits at 0.875.
Semiconductors are 21.3517 points behind over 63 sessions and NVDA is already 8.4245 percent lower, with the next scheduled information event not until the 2026-11-17 earnings.
